run_challenge_eval: run the NeurIPS challenge evaluation script with a prediction NPZ file and model name to compute success rates
run_is_successful: run the is_successful function to check if a predicted ML energy is within threshold of the DFT ground truth energy
run_compute_valid_ml_success: run compute_valid_ml_success to calculate validated ML success rates by comparing ML predictions against DFT ground truth data
run_get_dft_data: run get_dft_data to organize released target mappings into a nested dictionary for evaluation lookup by system and config ID
run_process_ml_data: run process_ml_data to load NPZ prediction results and map ML energies to system and config IDs with DFT validation
